'''Feather Falling''' is an [[enchantment]] for boots that reduces fall damage. [[Matcha Flavoured]] doubles its effect compared with vanilla ''Minecraft''.

== Obtaining ==
* The [[Elegy of Icarus]], a crafted [[blessing]], stores Feather Falling II.
* [[Sturdy Leather Boots]] are crafted with Feather Falling II, and those found in chests have Feather Falling III.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sturdy_leather_boots.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/equipment/sturdy_leather.json}}</ref>
* Random enchanted books in chests and fishing treasure, and trial chamber vaults.

== Behavior ==
Each level of Feather Falling gives 6 points of protection against fall damage, where vanilla gives 3. Each point reduces the damage by 4%, and protection from all enchantments is capped at 20 points (80%).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/enchantment/feather_falling.json}}</ref>

{| class="wikitable"
! Level !! Matcha Flavoured !! Vanilla
|-
| I || 24% || 12%
|-
| II || 48% || 24%
|-
| III || 72% || 36%
|-
| IV || 80% (capped; 96% before the cap) || 48%
|}

Its anvil cost multiplier is 1, down from 2.

{{History line|1.12.2|Protection per level doubled from 3 to 6 points.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=Feather Falling is better now (base damage reduction 12% -> 24%; max damage reduction 48% -> 72%)}}</ref>}}
}}

== Notes ==
* The {{Version|1.12.2}} release notes give the new maximum reduction as 72%, the value for level III. Feather Falling IV exists and reaches the 80% cap.
